Brand kit · adopted 27 Nov 2026

KG ProDesign
Shield Identity

The KGP hexagon shield and Anton lettering replace the red-slash script logo. The brand red moves to maroon #8C2828 (#6E1F1F in print). Custom software, web applications, and digital product design since 2005.

01 · Construction

How the shield is built

The shield is rebuilt as true vector from the draft, using fixed rules instead of a trace. Measurements are in shield units, where the whole mark is 1,675 units tall.

Maroon rim46u band, the outermost edge
White ring36u band. It separates the rim from the field and stays visible at 32px
Black fieldThe letters sit 57u inside it
KGP monogramAbout 125u strokes with 62u gaps. K and P are exact mirror images. The tops follow the shoulders and the bottoms follow the V
02 · Logo set

Every version

"Dark" files are made for dark backgrounds and have white lettering. "Light" files are for light backgrounds. The full-color shield has its own black field, so it works on either.

04 · Type

Lettering and fonts

Logo lettering: Anton, all capsKG PRODESIGN in Anton, the same face as the headlines. The outlines are built into the logo files, so no font install is needed. Always use the supplied files. Never retype the name in a font.
Built to last
Anton for headlinesCondensed all-caps headlines in posts and pages
We design and build custom software, web applications, and digital products.
Inter for body textParagraphs, UI, and captions
05 · Spacing

Clear space and minimum size

  • Clear space: leave at least the width of the P's stem (x, about 7.5% of the shield's height) on every side.
  • Shield: no smaller than 32px.
  • Horizontal lockup: no smaller than 32px tall. It was checked at 40px in a nav bar.
  • Wordmark: letters no smaller than 12px tall.
  • Favicon: at 16 and 32px, a small-size shield with a thick maroon rim and no white ring, so it stays red and crisp. From 48px up, the full shield.

The upper row is at 4x zoom to show the real pixels. The lower row is actual size.

06 · Social

Banners

A black field and the horizontal lockup. The name is underlined by a maroon bar its own width, with the tagline and kgprodesign.com below it in one column beside the shield. Large charcoal shield rims bleed off one edge, kept clear of the text. On X and LinkedIn the rims go on the left, behind the profile photo. Everything sits inside each platform's safe area.

07 · Misuse

Don't

Stretch or squash itScale it evenly, or pad it to fit.

Recolor the layersUse the full-color or the one-color files only.

Put it on a busy backgroundGive it a dark plate or use the one-color version.

KG ProDesign

Set the name in another fontLogos use the wordmark files. Plain-text "KG ProDesign" is fine where it is text, like the footer credit.

Print · for meeting people on the road

Business card and flyer

Print-ready PDFs at 300 dpi with a 0.125in bleed on every edge (backgrounds run into it, text stays 0.125in inside the trim, text is 6pt or larger), in the print maroon #6E1F1F. The QR codes open kgprodesign.com/contact/ with a tag for each piece (card or flyer), so you can tell where each lead came from. Copy by the marketing strategist: the feeling to leave people with is relief, "your website, handled".

Online printers (Vistaprint, MOO, etc.)print/business-card-2-sided.pdf · print/flyer-4x6.pdf. Bleed files: page 1 front, page 2 back, 0.125in bleed, TrimBox and BleedBox set
Local print shopprint/business-card-2-sided-cropmarks.pdf · print/flyer-4x6-cropmarks.pdf. The same art with crop marks at the trim
Proof with guidesprint/_print-proof.png (red = trim, green = safe area)
Rebuildpython build_print.py (needs segno for QR codes)
Draft · footer stamp

Footer stamp for client sites

A small credit that goes in the bottom bar of every site KG ProDesign builds. It links to kgprodesign.com. The label depends on hosting: "Dev & Hosted By" when KG ProDesign hosts the site, and "Developed By" when the client hosts it elsewhere. In each pair below, the dark footer shows the hosted label and the light footer shows the developed-only label. Below are three drafts, each on a sample client footer in dark and light. Decided 27 Nov 2026 · option B

Web theme for KGP sites

Today every KGP site uses the KGP plugin's blue Urban Gray Pearl theme with the Sora font. KG chose B: the default Urban Gray Pearl theme now uses brand maroon for buttons, links and focus rings (#8C2828 in light mode, the lighter #E07070 in dark mode, so links stay readable), and sites keep Sora. The other two options are shown for reference.

08 · Files

Which file where

Everything is in assets/brands/kgprodesign/kit-2026/ and rebuilds from kgp_geometry.py with python build_kit.py --all.

Website nav bar, dark headerlockup-horizontal/kgp-lockup-h-dark.svg
Website nav bar, light headerlockup-horizontal/kgp-lockup-h-light.svg
Logo with name, centeredlockup-stacked/kgp-lockup-stacked-{dark,light}.svg
Logo with tagline (banners, decks, email headers)lockup-tagline/kgp-lockup-tagline-{dark,light}.svg
Name onlywordmark/kgp-wordmark-{dark,light}.svg
Shield, any backgroundmark/kgp-mark-color.svg
Shield on white pages (optional, stronger edge)mark/kgp-mark-color-light-bg.svg
One color (print, engraving, embroidery)mark/kgp-mark-mono-{white,black,maroon}.svg
